d.ko: Hunt ghosts as two memorable characters in a story-driven Action-RPG where your decisions carry dramatic consequences. Torn between honoring your oath to the living and saving your departed partner, how far will you go for love?
d.en: Hunt ghosts as two memorable characters in a story-driven Action-RPG where your decisions carry dramatic consequences. Torn between honoring your oath to the living and saving your departed partner, how far will you go for love?
d.zh: 在这款以故事为驱动的动作角色扮演游戏中，你的决定将会带来戏剧性的后果。纠结于对生者履行誓言还是拯救你逝去的同伴，你会为爱走多远？
